Not sure what to do? Follow the steps below:
  1. From the available modules list (on the left side), select the module you wish to add.
  2. You may only have one instance of each module across all tabs. If the module is disabled (greyed-out) that means it's already in use. The tab where it's used will appear in parentheses.
  3. With a module selected, click the "Add To Tab" button under the module list of the tab where you wish to add the module.
  4. Use the arrows to the right of the module list to sort the modules in the desired order.
  5. To place modules into multiple columns, add the "Set Columns Widths" module to the tab list. This one may be added multiple times to each module. When you do this you will be asked to enter the width (as a percentage) of each column.
  6. To remove a module, select the module and click the "Remove From Tab" button under the tab module list.
  7. If a tab is empty, you may delete it by clicking the "Remove Tab" button.
  8. To add a new tab, click on the "Add New Tab" button. You may have a maximum of 10 tabs.
  9. To rename a tab, click on the original tab name (above the tab's module list). Note that the tab name changes will not be reflected on the full module list until the changes are saved.
  10. Note that the first or Main tab can not be deleted, renamed or reordered.
  11. After you have made the desired changes, click on the "Save Home Page Setup" button.
